notes.title: Important Version Update
notes.content:
03.06.2021
This is an important version update
A new rune card system has been added. And 59 new rune cards.
A synthesis system has been added.
A new Boss system has been added. Boss no longer uses the same refresh queue as zombies. Join 12 new Boss at the same time, the new Boss will have independent AI.
The assistant system has been reworked, and the limitation of assistant upgrade has been lifted.
The upper limit of star jade has been lifted, and more star jade can be obtained in the game.
The map and map system have been reworked, and several stores have been added.
At death,money will not be lost, and weapons can be kept in a safe.
After many updates, the total number of items in the game has reached 200. As you can see, in order to make the game better, I made a lot of changes and redoed it again and again. Of course, this update is not the last modification. I may keep this version for a while, hope you haven't missed it.
PS. Because the version has changed too much, this version will no longer be compatible with the old archive, I am very sorry for that.

notes.content:
Announcement

Fixed the bug of assistant's equipment
Add new boss
***********************************
11.21.2020
Add Buff MAXHP
Add Buff Fire enhancement: Increases the power of fire weapon and adds fireball when attacking
Add Buff Puncture: Bullets will penetrate enemies
Modified Buff Electric: increases the power of energy weapons
Modified Buff Starx2: Fixed bug
***********************************
11.15.2020
Add a new character
***********************************
10.29.2020
Added 3 new Boss: Hellhound
Increased bonus for killing Boss
***********************************
10.20.2020
In order to make the game more interesting, I greatly modified the game's playing method and strengthened the elements of survival
At the same time, a new kind of room is added to the scene, adding some items that can be picked up.
Some mathematical formulas are modified
Some items have been modified
***********************************
10.05.2020
New added team system, team system similar to RPG game equipment.
You can configure your partner's weapon before the game starts. You can upgrade them and change their weapons.
I added 15 replaceable weapons.
They have about 10 special abilities.
I hope the team will bring more fun.
I'm sorry I haven't updated the game for a month. I've been in the hospital for three weeks without a computer and Internet, which has disrupted my plan.
Now, I'm back home, but it's going to take a few weeks to recover, and the update will slowly recover.
